items.q: Is the generated robots.txt or sitemap safe to upload as it is?
items.a: Check it first. Make sure you are not blocking pages you want in Google, and that every URL in the sitemap works.

items.q: Which tool should I use first?
items.a: Start with robots.txt and the XML sitemap, then add 301 redirects when you move pages, and Open Graph tags for sharing.

items.q: Is the technical SEO toolkit free?
